propositions: The gate matches config field names globally, causing inert fields whose names collide with live fields on other configs to pass without read sites
A field is satisfied when its bare attribute name is read ANYWHERE under src/rebar on ANY config object, rather than being satisfied only by reads of the field's declaring dataclass instance

Field resolution must bind each read's receiver expression to the owning dataclass through six patterns: section-attribute name, parameter/variable annotations, local assignment propagation, function return annotations, IfExp/BoolOp branches, and cross-module parameter binding from call sites

Four live fields (McpConfig.readonly, McpConfig.allow_llm, McpConfig.allow_jira_sync, JiraConfig.allow_insecure) are newly flagged by the corrected gate and each carries an accurate # read-via: marker naming its real consumer
Existing # read-via: markers pointing to ticket ids must be reported when a referenced ticket closes, and pre-fix behavior must be frozen in tests to prove the RED-first discriminating case
